option_relations.rationale: Cerebral fungal abscess is a specific type of cerebral fungal infection. The option provides an example (invasive aspergillosis) which is consistent with the broader leaf.
Cerebral fungal infection is directly equivalent to the provided leaf. The example (cerebral aspergillosis) is a specific type of fungal infection.
Fungal brain abscess secondary to pulmonary infection is a specific type of cerebral fungal infection, with the added context of its origin.
Concurrent pulmonary and cerebral mucormycosis describes a specific type of cerebral fungal infection (mucormycosis) along with a co-occurring pulmonary infection.
